notes: Connected OSM course candidate. The selected loop is the longest simple source-node cycle after explicit exclusions; its association with a named circuit configuration requires review.
Source way order and shared node IDs are retained. No nearby endpoints are joined and no reference boundaries are read.
Some source ways lack one-way direction tags. Travel direction is provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 26 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Estimated painted-edge or pavement-to-grass transitions read on the pinned current ČÚZK Ortofoto image. Roughly half-metre reading increments and requested0.15m pixels do not establish positional or survey accuracy. Each intermediate cross-section interpolates; no nominal width is fitted. At the eastern triangular junction, both edges interpolate directly between measured coordinates at source stations305 and315 rather than following the local source kink. The inner edge at235-245 joins its observed points with straight segments to avoid source-normal folding near the small-radius curb. The selected connected course and travel direction remain provisional, timing missing, coarse terrain estimated, curbs illustrative and banking unknown. The inner edge at242 is omitted because its source normal folds back across the small-radius curb; it is not an independent observation in the reconstruction. Capture date is unconfirmed.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
